author: cmungall
body:
Uniprot has deleted 189 Pfal (UP000001450) proteins, claiming these are lost from ENSEMBL (although they appear to be present). Many of these have experimental GO annotations from GeneDB, with high importance to malarial biology. Most also are the sole representative of PDB structures, so presumably the deletion is a mistake.

This happened with UniProt Release 2026_04 (4 November 2026).

This doesn't affect QuickGO or the GOC downloads yet, but presumably this is just lag, and they will disappear the next release. We should try and avoid this. 

Full report here: https://claude.ai/artifact/J3gw1PVFpygXAoC1Ub1E7n
title: 189 Plasmodium falciparum 3D7 proteins deleted from UniProtKB
